utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — I heard you’re short on duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and some spare screws. If I come across any, I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and bring anything I find by. Glad to help out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got that spare drill and screwdrivers ready, and I’ll check the drill battery tonight so we can sort the rest once we know the time and any missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — can you let me know the repair drive time and what supplies are still needed once you hear back?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll check in tonight and let you know the time plus any supplies they still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, quick update, Uli — the repair drive’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep an ear out if anything changes again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — Sunday at the community center works. I appreciate you keeping it quiet and letting me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet, Uli — I’ll keep it quiet and let you know if I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — let’s start with the biggest repair needs first and sort the volunteers from there. Also, just a quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Rosa — I’ll start matching the biggest repairs with the right volunteers for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — I’ll keep the needs list updated and make sure everyone knows it’s Sunday at the community center. Let’s check in again once you’ve matched the first few repairs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at 9 at the community center works for me. I can bring the screwdriver set and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Sunday at 9 at the community center works. I’ll let the others know and keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Mina. I’ll be there and keep to the quiet tasks.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, glad I could help — I’ll swing by a bit late and check in once I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — thanks again. I’ll keep everything ready for when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would really help, Vik — once you send the timing and bring-list, I can check the logistics on my end.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still planning to bring my tools by the repair drive and help where they need it most. I’ll send the timing and bring-list so you can check the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for the timing and bring-list, then I can line up the logistics here.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it’s on — go ahead and tell folks. I’ll keep you updated as people reach out and say what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm—you’re really taking point on spreading the word and keeping me posted, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, I’ve got it—I'll spread the word and keep you posted as folks reach out and share what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m a bit late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re still good, Dane—just need the tools sorted and the last boxes labeled. If you grab those, we’ll be right on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll sort the tools and label the last boxes now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. I’ll wait for the latest tally.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m on it, Mina — I just need a minute to check the latest tally. I’ll tell you as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. I’ll wait right here for the latest tally.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, Gus — 9:30 Saturday works after the school run. Thanks for bringing the drill and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet — I’ll bring the drill and screwdrivers, and I’ll see you Saturday at 9:30 after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Gus — see you Saturday at 9:30 after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m happy to help, though I may need a reminder on the details. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — I’ll send the timing and the bring-list over, and then you can take it from there. I’m just trying to keep the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Pia — send it over and I’ll take it from there. I’m liable to forget a bit, so a quick reminder later wouldn’t hurt.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep an eye out and be ready right around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll send the exact time once the school run is done. Thanks for being flexible, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Much obliged, Faye. I’ll be ready when your note comes through after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Looks good to me — I’m set for the repair drive. Let me know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep tracking what’s left for the repair drive. Let me know if you still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Cleo — thanks for keeping track. I’m all set on my end.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — what time is the repair drive, and do we still need hands, tools, or any spare supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s at 10 this Saturday by the community hall, and we still need a few extra hands plus screwdrivers and spare nails if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I can ask around for a few extra hands, and Gus has a spare drill and screwdrivers. Do you still need nails, or should I bring anything else?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, Jules—I’ll keep spreading the word and point any handy neighbors your way. I’ll also mention you still need a few volunteers and some supplies sorted for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira—that helps a lot. I really appreciate you pointing folks our way for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course, Jules—I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out and send anyone interested your way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’s right — Sunday at the community center. Thanks for spreading the word, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll tell folks it’s Sunday at the community center. Thanks for keeping track, Opal!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You’re welcome, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for any more updates and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send it over when you can, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, Leo — I’ll send over the details and latest sign-up list soon. Thanks again for helping get the repair drive sorted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Mara — I’ll look it over as soon as it comes through.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll come Sunday to the community center and bring whatever tools you need for the urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey — that helps a lot. We’ll point you to the most urgent repairs when you arrive Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and ready to help with the urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll get the details out to everyone soon. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send the full repair drive details soon and spread the word. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check in and let you know what they need most first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for your update and go from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check back with them and tell you what they need most first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday around 9 at the community center and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam — Sunday at 9 at the community center works great. I’ll spread the word and let folks know that’s the new plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. See you Sunday at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Sunday at the community center. Thanks for the heads-up!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You’re welcome — I’ll send another reminder if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out for any more updates.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still happening, right? I’ll wait for the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on. I’ll send the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming — I’ll wait for your details then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — just send it over when Opal confirms, and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the exact details once Opal confirms.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it, Noah — I’ll be ready on Sunday at the community center. Just send the exact details when Opal confirms.
